name: write_ieee_comsoc_related_work
title: IEEE ComSoc Related Work Writer
description: Plan, review, or revise an IEEE ComSoc Related Work section from manuscript-defined comparisons, primary sources, and an optional literature ledger

project_dir.description: Project root containing the manuscript and any local literature ledger

manuscript_path.description: Path to the manuscript source containing its framing and, when already written, its Related Work section

mode.description: Whether to propose a structure, audit existing prose, or revise the manuscript

request.description: User instructions, scope boundaries, and venue-specific constraints

source_note_paths.description: Optional literature ledgers or source notes, including REFERENCES.md, REFERENCE.md, or equivalent files; these preserve research history but do not replace primary-source verification

subsection_titles.description: Optional fixed subsection titles that must be preserved

word_budget_per_subsection.description: Confirmed text-word budget for each subsection; omit when no limit has been established so the skill can open its length-confirmation gate

preserve_citation_set.description: Set to true only when the user requires the existing citation keys to remain fixed

subsection_axes.description: Manuscript-derived comparison dimensions; subsection_axes is retained as a compatibility field name
